lines.text: Paul says elders who lead well deserve double honor, and he quotes Scripture about not muzzling an ox treading grain.
Timothy should not entertain an accusation against an elder without two or three witnesses, and persistent sinners are rebuked so others fear sin.
Paul charges Timothy before God to act without partiality, to be quick in laying on hands, and to use a little wine.

wrong_details.wrong: to be quick in laying on hands
wrong_details.true: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands

lines.text: Some sins are obvious and go ahead to judgment, while good deeds that are inconspicuous cannot stay hidden.
Slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters all the more because they are elders.
